theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ z ∈ M₁, 0 < θ₁ z) → (∀ z ∈ M₂, 0 < θ₂ z) → x ∈ M₁ ∩ M₂ → (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ closedBall x ρ) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ∧ IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ closedBall x ρ) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in M₁ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₁ z) * ‖(M₁ ∩ M₂).indicator (fun w => θ₂ w / θ₁ w) z - θ₂ x / θ₁ x‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) / (∫⁻ z in M₁ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₁ z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in M₁ ∩ M₂ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₂ z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) / (∫⁻ z in M₂ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₂ z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫⁻ z in closedBall x s, ‖M₂.indicator θ₂ z - θ₂ x / θ₁ x * M₁.indicator θ₁ z‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * ∫⁻ z in M₁ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₁ z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
